+3R by 10am. Feeling unbeatable? That's the DANGER. 🧠

Three clean trades and the account is up 3R before 10am. Then the confidence kicks in: one more trade, a slightly bigger size, a setup that's only half there. Four impulsive trades later the day closes at -1R. The market didn't change. The trader's filter did. A big win is when discipline matters most.

1️⃣ Set a maximum number of trades per day before the open
2️⃣ Keep the same size after a winning streak
3️⃣ When you hit your daily target, close the platform
